title: Anna Karenina
synopsis: Imperial Russia. All happy families are alike; each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way. You're about to make a new way.

nodes.text: You arrive to help your brother's marriage. A man dies under the train.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Note the omen.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Survive—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He sees you and you see him. The room rearranges.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Withdraw.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Stay.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Your husband, kind in a clerk's way, asks about your trip.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Kitty wears white. You wear black. Vronsky chooses badly.

choices.consequence: “Leave early” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Your son is at the door. Seryozha hugs you.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Hold him long.” The story records the instinct as “Mother” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survive.

nodes.text: Vronsky's horse falls. You scream his name.

choices.consequence: “Recover the scream” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Society.
There is no taking “Don't recover” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He gives you a choice — be a wife, or be cut off entirely.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.

nodes.text: Vronsky and you, abroad. He paints. You are, for a month, free.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stay months.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Plan a return” back. Patient shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Your daughter. You do not love her the same way.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Society has, in your absence, decided.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Visit Seryozha.” The story records the instinct as “Mother” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: He cries against your dress. You can't, by law, take him.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Mother.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: A countess cuts you publicly.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hold your shoulders” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: Off-page, your brother-in-law marries. The country is, briefly, happy.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You begin to read Vronsky's mail.

choices.consequence: “Stop” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You take more, then more.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Cut back” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Take more.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He goes to Moscow. He writes a vague letter.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Pride.
There is no taking “Send a soft one” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You ride into town to find him.

choices.text: Wait at the station for the next train
choices.consequence: You commit to “Wait at the station for the next train.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
“Take a cab” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: Faces blur. The bell. Your shawl is heavy.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Save.
You commit to “Step forward.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A man dies under the train. You can choose another ending.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Choose another” back. Save shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Step” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: If you stepped back, you sit on a bench with shaking hands.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Go home.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
“Leave Vronsky” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.

nodes.text: Far away, your brother-in-law in a hayfield finds peace. He thinks of you, sometimes.

choices.consequence: “Send him a letter” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You step. The book closes on you. Vronsky goes to a war and dies. Karenin raises Seryozha and Annie. Years pass.
You step back. You move, alone, to Italy. You raise Annie in a small house. You read, late, that Vronsky has, in Serbia, found a war.
Levin's chapter outlives yours. He raises his children. He thinks of you in a hayfield, every year, when the light is right. You exist, in him, as a small daily prayer.
